text_en: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign; he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jedidah daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath.
text_cn: 约史雅登极时才八岁，在耶路撒冷作王凡三十一年，他的母亲名叫耶狄达，是波兹卡特人阿达雅的女儿。

text_en: He did what was right in the sight of the Lord , and walked in all the way of his father David; he did not turn aside to the right or to the left.
text_cn: 他行了上主视为正义的事，在一切事上，走了他祖先达味的路。不偏左也不偏右。

text_en: In the eighteenth year of King Josiah, the king sent Shaphan son of Azaliah, son of Meshullam, the secretary, to the house of the Lord , saying,
text_cn: 约史雅为王十八年时，派默叔蓝的孙子，阿匝里雅的儿子沙番书记到上主的殿里去，吩咐他说：

text_en: “Go up to the high priest Hilkiah, and have him count the entire sum of the money that has been brought into the house of the Lord , which the keepers of the threshold have collected from the people;
text_cn: “你上去见大司祭希耳克雅，请他将献于上主圣殿，和守门人由人民收来的银钱结算清楚，

text_en: let it be given into the hand of the workers who have the oversight of the house of the Lord ; let them give it to the workers who are at the house of the Lord , repairing the house,
text_cn: 交给那些在上主殿内监工的人，叫他们发给那些在上主殿内工作和修理圣殿破坏地方的工人，

text_en: that is, to the carpenters, to the builders, to the masons; and let them use it to buy timber and quarried stone to repair the house.
text_cn: 即木匠、工人和泥水匠，或购买修理圣殿的木料和凿好的石头。

text_en: But no accounting shall be asked from them for the money that is delivered into their hand, for they deal honestly. ”
text_cn: 银子交给他们之后，不必再同他们算账，因为他们都是办事很忠信的人。”

text_en: The high priest Hilkiah said to Shaphan the secretary, “I have found the book of the law in the house of the Lord . ” When Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, he read it.
text_cn: 大司祭希耳克雅对沙番书记说：“我在上主殿内发现了法律书。”希耳克雅将这卷书交给了沙番，沙番读了。

text_en: Then Shaphan the secretary came to the king, and reported to the king, “Your servants have emptied out the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of the workers who have oversight of the house of the Lord . ”
text_cn: 沙番书记遂来见君王，向君王报告说：“你的仆人已将圣殿内所有的银钱倒出来，交给了那些在上主殿内监工的人。”

text_en: Shaphan the secretary informed the king, “The priest Hilkiah has given me a book. ” Shaphan then read it aloud to the king.
text_cn: 沙番书记继而又向君王报告说：“大司祭希耳克雅交给我一卷书。”沙番就在君王面前朗读了那书。

text_en: When the king heard the words of the book of the law, he tore his clothes.
text_cn: 君王一听了法律书上的话，就撕裂了自己的衣服，

text_en: Then the king commanded the priest Hilkiah, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Achbor son of Micaiah, Shaphan the secretary, and the king’s servant Asaiah, saying,
text_cn: 即刻吩咐大司祭希耳克雅，沙番的儿子阿希甘，米加的儿子阿革波尔，沙番书记和君王的臣仆阿撒雅说：

text_en: “Go, inquire of the Lord for me, for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that has been found; for great is the wrath of the Lord that is kindled against us, because our ancestors did not obey the words of this book, to do according to all that is written concerning us. ”
text_cn: “你们为我，为人民，为全犹大，去求问上主关于所发现的书上的话；因为我们的祖先没有听从这卷书上的话，也没有按照这卷书上所记载的去实行，所以上主对我们大发忿怒。”

text_en: So the priest Hilkiah, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, and Asaiah went to the prophetess Huldah the wife of Shallum son of Tikvah, son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe; she resided in Jerusalem in the Second Quarter, where they consulted her.
text_cn: 大司祭希耳克雅、阿希甘、阿革波尔、沙番和阿撒雅，于是去见住在耶路撒冷新市区，哈尔哈斯的孙子，提刻瓦的儿子，管理祭衣的沙隆的妻子，女先知胡耳达，向她说明了来意以后，

text_en: She declared to them, “Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel: Tell the man who sent you to me,
text_cn: 她就回答他们说：“上主以色列的天主这样说：你们去回报那派你们来见我的人说：

text_en: Thus says the Lord , I will indeed bring disaster on this place and on its inhabitants—all the words of the book that the king of Judah has read.
text_cn: 上主这样说：看，我必要依照犹大王所读的那卷书上的一切话：使灾祸降在这地方和这地方的居民身上，

text_en: Because they have abandoned me and have made offerings to other gods, so that they have provoked me to anger with all the work of their hands, therefore my wrath will be kindled against this place, and it will not be quenched.
text_cn: 因为他们舍弃了我，向别的神焚香。凡他们所做的，无不惹我动怒；所以我的怒火要向这地方发作，总不熄灭。

text_en: But as to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the Lord , thus shall you say to him, Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel: Regarding the words that you have heard,
text_cn: 至于那派你们来求问上主的犹大王，你们要这样对他说：上主以色列的天主这样说：你既然听了这些话，

text_en: because your heart was penitent, and you humbled yourself before the Lord , when you heard how I spoke against this place, and against its inhabitants, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and because you have torn your clothes and wept before me, I also have heard you, says the Lord .
text_cn: 既然一听见我指着这地和这地上的居民，说他们必要成为令人惊骇和诅咒的对象，你就动了心，在我面前自卑自贱，撕裂了自己的衣服，在我面前痛哭，因此我也应允了你：上主的断语。

text_en: Therefore, I will gather you to your ancestors, and you shall be gathered to your grave in peace; your eyes shall not see all the disaster that I will bring on this place. ” They took the message back to the king.
text_cn: 我要使你与你的祖先团聚，你要平安归到你的坟墓里，你的眼睛也不会见到我在这地方所要降的一切灾祸。”他们回去向君王报告了这话。
